question: Which of the following Amendment Acts of the Constitution of India conferred statehood to Goa and formed a new union territory comprising of Daman and Diu?
solution:
The correct answer is **__56th Amendment Act.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **56th Constitution Amendment **

 
 
• Under this amendment, on 30 May 1987, Goa was given the status of a separate state.
 
• Goa became the 25th state of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Amendment**
 **Subject**
 
 

 **23rd Amendment Act**
 
 
 
• It is officially known as The Constitution (Twenty-third Amendment) Act, 1969, **discontinued reservation of seats for the Scheduled Tribes in Nagaland**, both in the Lok Sabha and the State Legislative Assembly.
 
 
 
 

 **67th Amendment Act**
 
 
 
• The Constitution (Sixty-seventh Amendment) Act, 1990 Amendment of Article 356.
 
• In Article 356 of the Constitution, in clause (4), in the third proviso for the words** "three years and six months", the words "four years"** shall be substituted.
 
 
 
 

 **45th Amendment Act**
 
 
 
• It is officially known as The Constitution (Forty-fifth Amendment) Act, 1980, **extended the period of reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes and representation of the Anglo-Indians** in the Lok Sabha and the State Legislative Assemblies.
